about_the_game:
🐔 ClusterCluck

Welcome to the coop!
ClusterCluck is an online multiplayer social deduction party game for 5–10 players, where your mission is to expose the hidden killer before disaster strikes.
At the start of each match, every player is assigned a random role: are you one of the Chickens… or a sneaky Fox in disguise?
Be careful! Every fox in the coop wears feathers.

Roles

🐔 Chicken Team

The Chickens’ goal is to complete tasks, gather clues, and survive the night against the Foxes!

  • Chicken: Uses eggs as defensive tools and is a master of quick escapes.

  • Guardian: Shields teammates and can create a massive protective barrier.

  • Mage: Resurrects fallen allies and clones itself to create chaos.

  • Watcher: Turns invisible to reveal another player’s true identity.

🦊 Fox Team

The Foxes’ goal is to secretly eliminate Chickens and manipulate the voting phase to their advantage.

  • Fox: Tracks Chickens by scent, sets traps, and strikes with deadly attacks.

  • Snow Fox: Freezes Chickens in place, stunning them and allowing allies to strike.

🎮 Three Game Modes, Endless Chaos

ClusterCluck adapts to your group size with three unique game systems:

🐥 Mini Game (5–6 Players):
1 Fox and 3 Chicken roles. Fast-paced, tense, and full of paranoia.

🐔 Intermediate Game (7–8 Players):
Starts with 1 Fox and 3 Chicken roles.
There’s also a 50% chance of an extra Fox or Chicken role appearing. The balance can shift at any moment!

🦊 Standard Game (9–10 Players):
2 Foxes and 4 Chicken roles for full-scale chaos.

🗝️ Mystery Chests

Two types of hidden chests lie scattered across the map:

Mole’s Chest (Common): Offers simple but useful clues.
Owl’s Chest (Rare): Harder to find, but holds far more valuable information.

These chests reveal hints about who the killer might be — but be warned, not every clue can be trusted.
How you use that information is entirely up to you!

Missions: The Key to Escape

The coop’s doors are powered by electricity, but the system has failed.
To escape, players must complete both team and individual objectives.

Team Mission – Fix the Switches:
Repair the electrical system together to power up the coop.

  • Mini Game: 3 switches

  • Medium Game: 4 switches

  • Standard Game: 5 switches

Individual Mission – Rescue Your Chicks:
Each Chicken must find and free their baby chicks trapped in cages around the map.
Once all chicks are rescued, the coop doors open, and players gain access to the voting phase.

Two Phases of Suspense

1. Survival Phase:
Foxes disguise themselves as Chickens, and suspicion spreads fast.
Complete your tasks, collect clues, and stay alert.
But beware, once the timer runs out, the Foxes will show their true faces!

2. Voting Phase:
The survivors gather, accusations fly, and chaos takes over.
Trust the wrong player, and it could cost the entire coop.
If you’re a Fox, deception is your greatest weapon.

In ClusterCluck, Trust Can Be Fatal.

Control the chaos. Build your strategy. Protect your team...

Or put on your mask and blend in, 
because in this coop, anyone could be the next meal.
detailed_description:
Cosmetics Update!

🐔✨ Cosmetic Update!

Chickens can now show off their style! Earn in-game currency just by playing, then spend it in the market to unlock hilarious hats, flashy outfits, and more...


The ClusterCluck DISCORD Server is LIVE!

🎉 The ClusterCluck Discord Server is Live! 🐔

Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that the official ClusterCluck Discord server is now open!
Join our growing community to stay up to date with development news, share feedback, connect with other players, and be a part of the chaos.

🎮 What’s Inside?
• Dev updates and patch notes
• Tips, tricks, and strategies
• Community events and discussions
• Feedback & bug report channels
• And plenty of chicken-fueled mayhem!

🧠 Your voice matters.
Whether you’ve got suggestions, bug reports, or just want to share a funny in-game moment — we’d love to hear from you.

See you there!
— The ClusterCluck Team

short_description: Compete or cooperate in chaotic mini-games with friends or online players! ClusterCluck is a fast-paced multiplayer arena packed with action, co-op fun, and unpredictable mayhem.
